metric_units_and_conventions.$doc: document 38 section 4.1 — fractional units in storage, labeled percentages in display only. The x52 convention is the runner's declared weekly_arithmetic_mean_x_52.
metric_units_and_conventions.activity.traded: boolean: at least one closed trade
metric_units_and_conventions.annual_rap: fraction per year, weekly RAP arithmetic mean x 52
metric_units_and_conventions.annual_return: fraction per year, weekly arithmetic mean x 52
metric_units_and_conventions.annualized_return: compounded fraction per year: (1+total_return)^(365.25/days)-1 over the outer scored window
metric_units_and_conventions.max_drawdown_fraction: fraction of peak equity over the whole outer scored window
metric_units_and_conventions.mean_weekly_rap: fraction per week: weekly return - lambda x weekly max drawdown (risk-adjusted performance)
metric_units_and_conventions.trades_total: count of closed trades, outer scored window
metric_units_and_conventions.weekly_return_vector: fraction per calendar week (W-SUN), outer validation 2024 scored window

conditional_stratum_report.$doc: SEPARATE from the formal aggregate outcome, which stays INCONCLUSIVE. This report answers the two questions the order asks, and NOTHING else.

question_a.question: was phase-1 LR 1e-4 inactive under BOTH phase-1 difficulties?
question_a.evidence: 8 of 8 cells at LR 1e-4 (4 seeds x {normal_realistic, easy_chronological_continuation}) terminated with activity_status=inactive, cause no_activity_eligible_checkpoint, 0 closed trades on their diagnostic outer evaluation. Every trained phase-1 checkpoint at 1e-4 is typed CONSTANT_POLICY with any_action_crosses_phase2_threshold=false and probe_trades_total=0, under both difficulties.
question_a.scope: this is an activity/viability statement, not a performance statement; no return number is attributed to a 1e-4 arm

question_b.question: inside the viable 3e-5 stratum, did easy have a sign-consistent advantage over normal?
question_b.comparator: paired within seed, easy minus normal, on outer_validation mean_weekly_rap (fraction per week, 2024 scored window) — the same utility the runner uses

directional_consistency.rule: the runner's declared materiality rule: all four per-seed paired deltas share ONE strict sign
directional_consistency.verdict: NOT sign-consistent: one seed positive, one seed negative, two seeds exactly zero

magnitude.$doc: reported SEPARATELY from directional consistency, per document 38 section 15

practical_materiality.statement: no practical-materiality threshold was predeclared for the easy-versus-normal delta inside the 3e-5 stratum. A merely nonzero sign-consistent delta would NOT be 'material' without such a threshold, and this delta is not even sign-consistent. No materiality claim is made in either direction.

question_b.conclusion: inside the viable 3e-5 stratum the phase-1 difficulty factor shows NO sign-consistent advantage for easy over normal on 2024 outer validation. Combined with question_a this supports freezing L1 to normal_realistic at 3e-5 for the L2 program on grounds of viability and simplicity, NOT on grounds of a demonstrated performance advantage.

sealed_test_custody.evidence: all 16 records bind nested_role_facts.sealed_test = {status: SEALED, csv_sha256: null, scored_rows: null, score_start: null, score_end: null, context_rows: null}
sealed_test_custody.leak_scan: all 16 cell_record.json files scanned for any 2025 date materialization: 0 hits
sealed_test_custody.labelling_rule: every number in this evidence file is 2024 OUTER-VALIDATION evidence under the L1 nested contract. None of it is 2025 release performance, and none of it may be described as such.

residual_doubts.title: the promoted best checkpoint of every active cell is the phase-1 handoff policy; phase-2 normal training contributed nothing
residual_doubts.evidence: for all 8 active cells the policy-tensor sha256 of the selected best checkpoint (model.zip) is bit-identical to boundary_transfer_evidence.source_policy_tensor_hash, i.e. the phase-1 artifact transferred at the boundary. In every epoch_history, phase-2 epoch 0 (checkpoint_source=warm_start_normal_baseline) is the only epoch whose early_stop_trade_gate_passed is true; epochs 1..79 all report composite=-1000000.0, composite_raw=0.0 and zero trades, and best_composite never moves off its epoch-0 value.
residual_doubts.consequence: the 2024 outer numbers for the 3e-5 arms measure the PHASE-1 policy evaluated under normal-realistic conditions. The phase-1 difficulty x LR contrast is still the thing that varies, so the conditional-stratum conclusion holds, but no claim may be made about phase-2 normal training.

residual_doubts.title: every cell stopped at epoch 80 of a declared 2000 pass-equivalent ceiling
residual_doubts.evidence: all 16 cells report stop_reason=activity_stop_no_eligible_checkpoint at exactly 80 epochs and 1,579,000 gradient updates. The binding stop was the activity patience (l1_activity_patience=40, start epoch 40), not the document-38 paired-generalization patience (60, floor 40, max 2000).
residual_doubts.consequence: about 4 percent of the declared per-cell budget was spent. The factorial is a valid measurement of what these treatments do under the AS-RUN stopping contract; it is not evidence about the full document-38 2000-checkpoint contract.

residual_doubts.title: the four seeds are not four independent outcomes: 5 distinct outer weekly vectors among 8 active cells, including a cross-seed collision
residual_doubts.evidence: distinct weekly_return_vector sha256 values among active cells: 5. seed202/P1E_LR3E5, seed202/P1N_LR3E5 and seed303/P1N_LR3E5 share one bit-identical 2024 weekly P&L vector (125 trades) despite distinct model artifacts on different hosts; seed404/P1E_LR3E5 and seed404/P1N_LR3E5 share another (124 trades).
residual_doubts.consequence: distinct weights are collapsing onto the same discretized action sequence, which is why two of the four paired deltas are exactly 0.0. Effective replication is weaker than n=4, so the sign-consistency test in this stratum is underpowered. This weakens any future positive claim more than it weakens the present negative one.

residual_doubts.title: phase-1 per-checkpoint telemetry labels every phase-1 epoch checkpoint_source='easy_training_epoch' even in normal_realistic cells
residual_doubts.evidence: P1N cells carry checkpoint_source='easy_training_epoch' on phase-1 epochs 1..4 while factors.phase1_dynamics='normal_realistic' and phase1_mode='normal_realistic'.
residual_doubts.consequence: a naming wart in telemetry only. The factor itself is correctly applied and separable: phase1_mode, resolved_config_sha256 and phase1_artifact_sha256 all differ per cell.

residual_doubts.title: collection tree digests differ between the two seals
residual_doubts.evidence: 6877945c… (2026-08-14) vs e21c00c2… (2026-08-15); the only differing files are four seed101 heartbeat.json liveness files.
residual_doubts.consequence: expected and benign: heartbeats are mutable liveness telemetry that lives inside the fetched subtree. Consider excluding heartbeat files from the sealed tree digest so a re-collection is byte-reproducible.

residual_doubts.title: no absolute performance claim is supported by these numbers
residual_doubts.evidence: every active arm has NEGATIVE mean weekly RAP on 2024 outer validation (range -0.004367 to -0.001570 fraction per week), and mean weekly return spans -0.000253 to +0.000561 fraction per week.
residual_doubts.consequence: nothing here is promotable, and nothing here is a champion. The 2025 sealed test is untouched and remains the only release evidence.
